evidence.observedFact: The active business website lists current operating hours, a Mentor address, appointment scheduling, and a published cancellation-policy section.

The salon states that last-minute cancellations and no-shows can leave appointment time unfilled and says repeat no-shows or cancellations inside 24 hours are charged 50% of the missed appointment cost at the next visit.
The salon describes itself as an independent Mentor business founded in 2012 and explicitly says its customer strategy is to attract customers and keep customers with exceptional service.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate automated confirmation, reminder, waitlist-fill, and missed-appointment recovery workflows tied to appointment status.
Demonstrate a respectful win-back workflow for lapsed clients and customers affected by cancellation/no-show events.

recommendedEntryOffer: Booking Recovery + Client Reactivation Revenue Engine
notes: Observed fact: the salon publicly documents last-minute cancellation/no-show friction and an explicit customer-retention objective. Hypothesis: Places Rewards could improve recovery and reactivation; no monetary loss is asserted beyond the salon's own general statement that unfilled missed appointments hurt staff financially.
